blocks.text: Hemlock Valley: Sasquatch Mountain Resort Living

parts.t: Hemlock Valley is the mountain community around Sasquatch Mountain Resort, east of Mission along the Agassiz–Harrison corridor. Buyers look here for cabin and chalet-style homes, ski-oriented recreational properties, and a quieter pace than urban Mission neighbourhoods.

Listings commonly include mountain homes and cabins near the resort area rather than suburban tree-lined streets or walk-to-elementary lifestyles. Access, elevation, and recreational use matter as much as square footage.
